entry_points.sample_mode: docker compose --profile sample up --build app-sample ui-sample

zetaris.role: federated SQL over four sources (3 JDBC Postgres, 1 REST); USL model recallguard_usl + view recallguard.product_exposure_v as the semantic layer; catalogue discovery; Critic verification queries on the raw tables

meterless.role: Nightshift is the model provider (LLM_PROVIDER=meterless, no direct NVIDIA client); World Model engine holds provenance-tracked entities; H-MEM keeps verified aliases and pharmacist verdicts across runs

nvidia.role: Nemotron served through Meterless Nightshift lanes for the Reconciler's ambiguous-match decisions and the Reporter's summary

data.real: data.gov.my pharmaceutical registers (CC BY 4.0); NPRA product recall notices snapshot (Jan 2023 - Aug 2026); NPRA DRGD Appendix 34 recall guideline
data.synthetic: inventory, stock transfers, POS sales, supplier deliveries (scripts/generate_synthetic.py; seeds 42 sample, 7 tuning, 99 hold-out)

evaluation: scripts/evaluate.py; hold-out seed 99: 31/31 exposures found, precision 0.91, 0 decoys flagged (24 Oct)
